package course

import (
	"context"
	"strings"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/contentaccess"
)

// GetCourseOutline loads the complete lightweight navigation tree for one
// visible course and attaches audience-specific lesson reading decisions.
type GetCourseOutline struct {
	Outlines repository.CourseOutlineRepository
	Access   contentaccess.Service
}

func (uc GetCourseOutline) Handle(ctx context.Context, courseID string, lang string) (*domain.CourseOutline, error) {
	courseID = strings.TrimSpace(courseID)
	if courseID == "" || uc.Outlines == nil {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}

	outline, err := uc.Outlines.GetPublic(ctx, courseID, strings.TrimSpace(lang))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	lessonIDs := uniqueOutlineLessonIDs(outline)
	decisions, err := uc.Access.ResolveCourseLessons(ctx, courseID, lessonIDs)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	for moduleIndex := range outline.Modules {
		for sectionIndex := range outline.Modules[moduleIndex].Sections {
			lessons := outline.Modules[moduleIndex].Sections[sectionIndex].Lessons
			for lessonIndex := range lessons {
				decision, ok := decisions[lessons[lessonIndex].ID]
				if !ok {
					return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
				}
				lessons[lessonIndex].EffectiveReadAccess = decision.Effective
				lessons[lessonIndex].CanRead = decision.CanRead
			}
		}
	}
	return outline, nil
}

func uniqueOutlineLessonIDs(outline *domain.CourseOutline) []string {
	seen := make(map[string]struct{})
	result := make([]string, 0)
	for _, module := range outline.Modules {
		for _, section := range module.Sections {
			for _, lesson := range section.Lessons {
				if _, ok := seen[lesson.ID]; ok {
					continue
				}
				seen[lesson.ID] = struct{}{}
				result = append(result, lesson.ID)
			}
		}
	}
	return result
}
